mapper.sql: t.* , out_order.out_no AS out_order_no , out_line.line_no AS out_order_line_no , out_line.mat_code AS mat_code , out_line.mat_name AS mat_name , out_line.plan_qty AS plan_qty

FROM wms_wave_line t LEFT JOIN wms_out_order out_order ON out_order.id = t.out_order_id AND out_order.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN wms_out_order_line out_line ON out_line.id = t.out_order_line_id AND out_line.deleted = 0
mapper.select:
SELECT
ORDER BY t.priority DESC, t.line_no ASC
